verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent provider, so buying agent service online and receiving the agent name and street address for a filing is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no content about this capability. Both probes record only that the CT Corporation pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge on www.wolterskluwer.com, and that the legacy host redirects into that wall. With no evidence of online purchase or same-day agent details, the verdict is none; confidence is low because the gap reflects inaccessible pages rather than a documented absence.
